question: Which syntax-highlighting theme pair should be the default for docs.mctl.ai code blocks?
reason: Issue #160 states the choice belongs to the requester and cannot be inferred from the repository; the proposal sets markdown.theme in docs/.vitepress/config.ts to exactly one of these pairs. Until answered, the proposal assumes option 1 because it equals VitePress 1.6's built-in default and changes nothing visually.

options: github-light / github-dark (matches the GitHub look most readers know)
one-light / one-dark-pro (higher contrast, closer to the MCTL design tokens)
